name: box group
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 4 ticks after Start.
Box 0: 6 cells, starting at (0, 1, 1) through (1, 4, 1); Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Box 1: 4 cells, starting at (1, 2, 1) through (2, 3, 1); Box 2: 6 cells, starting at (2, 1, 1) through (3, 4, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Box 0 moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north; Box 1 moves 1 north; Box 2 moves 1 north.
Ticks 2–3 (each tick): Box 2 moves 1 down.
Tick 4: Box 2 disappears.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
